Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Worker night shift position in Oostkamp. With recent experience in a high-volume logistics environment at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, I am comfortable with the physical demands of warehouse work and familiar with maintaining accuracy and efficiency. I am a night owl and prefer working during night hours. I have my own transportation and am legally permitted to work in Belgium.

I am eager to join a stable logistics company where I can contribute and grow. The opportunity for internal reach truck training is particularly appealing, and I am ready to start as soon as possible. I am comfortable working in English and have a basic knowledge of Dutch.

Please find my CV attached. I would be delighted to discuss my application further. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker night shift position in Oostkamp. Having recently worked in a high-volume logistics environment at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, I understand the importance of accuracy, efficiency, and safety in warehouse operations. I am a true night owl, performing at my best during night hours, and I am ready to bring my strong work ethic to your team.

In my previous warehouse role, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a fast-paced setting, which has prepared me for the responsibilities of loading and unloading trucks, performing quality checks, and keeping the warehouse organized. I am comfortable operating electrical pallet trucks and am keen to expand my skills with reach truck training. I am not afraid of working in cold environments and am fully prepared to handle the freezer conditions with the provided thermal clothing and equipment.

I am already living in Belgium with my own transportation, and I have legal permission to work here. I am available to start immediately and am looking for a stable, long-term opportunity. The English-speaking environment is ideal for me, as I am fluent in English and have a basic knowledge of Dutch.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the job security and the potential for growth within the company. The internal training and coaching, as well as the future reach truck training, align perfectly with my career goals. I am confident that my dedication and reliability will make me a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your logistics operations.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
